package student

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type PracticeTaskCatalog interface {
	GetRuntimeContext(ctx context.Context, practiceTaskID string) (*domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, error)
	GetPublishedRuntimeContext(ctx context.Context, practiceTaskID string) (*domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, error)
	GetRevisionRuntimeContext(ctx context.Context, revisionID string) (*domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, error)
	GetRevisionEvaluationContext(ctx context.Context, revisionID string) (*domain.PracticeTaskEvaluationContext, error)
}
